card.name: Punctuation before a title or quoted phrase
card.fires_on: Punctuation such as a comma, colon or dash that sits right before a headline, title or quoted statement in general web text. It also fires inside a few words in quoted headlines.

modes.label: Colon or comma before a title
modes.description: A colon or comma that introduces a book title, a link heading or an appositive description of a person.

modes.label: Dash between news items
modes.description: A dash separating a timestamp or a news item from the next headline in lists of news links.
modes.example: Watch a 'ring of fire' solar eclipse online <<->> Teen's space mission fueled by social media

modes.label: Inside headline words
modes.description: The middle of a word within a quoted headline or a quoted phrase.
modes.example: the New York Times' headline "Tw<<entieth>> Century's Triumphant Entry" on

card.plain: It fires on the comma, colon or dash that comes just before a headline or a title in web text.
